title.raw: 卷三十一 列傳第二十五: 蕭摩訶 任忠 樊毅 魯廣達 Volume 31: Xiao Mohe; Ren Zhong; Fan Yi; Lu Guangda

sentences.zh: 陳書卷三十一

translations.literal: Book of Chen, Volume 31
translations.idiomatic: Book of Chen, Volume 31

sentences.zh: 列傳第二十五

translations.literal: Biographies, Number Twenty-five
translations.idiomatic: Biographies, Part Twenty-five

sentences.zh: 蕭摩訶 任忠 樊毅弟猛 魯廣達

translations.literal: Xiao Mohe; Ren Zhong; Fan Yi; his younger brother Meng; Lu Guangda
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Mohe; Ren Zhong; Fan Yi; his younger brother Meng; Lu Guangda

sentences.zh: 蕭摩訶字元胤，蘭陵人也。

translations.literal: Xiao Mohe, styled Yuanyin, was a native of Lanling.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Mohe, styled Yuanyin, came from Lanling.

sentences.zh: 祖靚，梁右將軍。

translations.literal: His grandfather Jing was a Right General of Liang.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Jing had been a Liang right general.

sentences.zh: 父諒，梁始興郡丞。

translations.literal: His father Liang was Assistant Administrator of Shixing commandery under Liang.
translations.idiomatic: His father Liang had been assistant administrator of Shixing commandery under Liang.

sentences.zh: 摩訶隨父之郡，年數歲而父卒，其姑夫蔡路養時在南康，〔一〕乃收養之。

translations.literal: Mohe followed his father to the commandery; when he was only a few years old his father died. His uncle by marriage Cai Luyang was then at Nankang, Editorial footnote marker 1. and took him in to raise.
translations.idiomatic: Mohe went with his father to the commandery; when he was only a few years old his father died. His uncle by marriage Cai Luyang was then at Nankang [1] and took him in to raise.

sentences.zh: 稍長，果毅有勇力。

translations.literal: When he grew somewhat older he was resolute and brave, with surpassing strength.
translations.idiomatic: As he grew he proved resolute and brave, with surpassing strength.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，高祖赴援京師，路養起兵拒高祖，摩訶時年十三，單騎出戰，軍中莫有當者。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion the Founder went to relieve the capital; Luyang raised troops to resist the Founder. Mohe was then thirteen and rode out alone to fight; in the army none could stand against him.
translations.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion the Founder marched to relieve the capital. Luyang raised troops to resist him. Mohe was then thirteen and rode out alone to fight; in the army none could stand against him.

sentences.zh: 及路養敗，摩訶歸于侯安都，安都遇之甚厚，自此常隸安都征討。

translations.literal: When Luyang was defeated, Mohe went over to Hou Andu, and Andu treated him with great favor; from then on he regularly served under Andu on campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: When Luyang was defeated, Mohe joined Hou Andu, who treated him with great favor; thereafter he regularly campaigned under Andu.

sentences.zh: 及任約、徐嗣徽引齊兵為寇，高祖遣安都北拒齊軍於鍾山龍尾及北郊壇。

translations.literal: When Ren Yue and Xu Sihui led Qi troops in raiding, the Founder sent Andu north to hold off the Qi army at Dragon Tail on Bell Mountain and at the Northern Suburban Altar.
translations.idiomatic: When Ren Yue and Xu Sihui led Qi troops in raiding, the Founder sent Andu north to hold off the Qi army at Dragon Tail on Bell Mountain and at the Northern Suburban Altar.

sentences.zh: 安都謂摩訶曰：「卿驍勇有名，千聞不如一見。

translations.literal: Andu said to Mohe: "You are famed for valor—hearing a thousand times is not equal to seeing once.
translations.idiomatic: Andu told Mohe, "You are famed for valor—hearing a thousand times is not equal to seeing once.

sentences.zh: 」摩訶對曰：「今日令公見矣。

translations.literal: " Mohe replied: "Today let the lord see.
translations.idiomatic: " Mohe replied, "Today let the lord see."

sentences.zh: 」及戰，安都墜馬被圍，摩訶獨騎大呼，直衝齊軍，齊軍披靡，因稍解去，安都乃免。

translations.literal: " When battle came, Andu fell from his horse and was surrounded; Mohe alone on horseback shouted and charged straight through the Qi army. The Qi army broke and scattered, and he was thus able to break free; Andu was saved.
translations.idiomatic: When battle came, Andu fell from his horse and was surrounded. Mohe alone on horseback shouted and charged straight through the Qi army. The Qi ranks broke and scattered, and he was thus able to break free; Andu was saved.

sentences.zh: 天嘉初，除本縣令，以平留異、歐陽紇之功，累遷巴山太守。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Tiancheng he was made magistrate of his home county; for merit in pacifying Liu Yi and Ouyang He he was repeatedly promoted to Administrator of Bashan.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Tiancheng (560) he was made magistrate of his home county; for merit in pacifying Liu Yi and Ouyang He he was repeatedly promoted to administrator of Bashan.

sentences.zh: 太建五年，眾軍北伐，摩訶隨都督吳明徹濟江攻秦郡。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Taijian the mass of armies marched north; Mohe followed Area Commander Wu Mingche across the river to attack Qin commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Taijian year 5 (573) the armies marched north; Mohe followed area commander Wu Mingche across the river to attack Qin commandery.

sentences.zh: 時齊遣大將尉破胡等率眾十萬來援，其前隊有「蒼頭」、「犀角」、「大力」之號，皆身長八尺，膂力絕倫，其鋒甚銳。

translations.literal: At that time Qi sent the great general Wei Pohu and others leading a host of a hundred thousand to relieve them; their vanguard bore the names "Blue-Head," "Rhino-Horn," and "Great-Strength"—all eight feet tall, with strength beyond the common run, and their spearhead was very sharp.
translations.idiomatic: Qi then sent the great general Wei Pohu and others with a host of a hundred thousand to relieve them. Their vanguard bore the names Blue-Head, Rhino-Horn, and Great-Strength—all eight feet tall, with strength beyond the common run, and their spearhead was very sharp.

sentences.zh: 又有西域胡，妙於弓矢，弦無虛發，眾軍尤憚之。

translations.literal: There were also Western Region barbarians skilled with bow and arrow who never missed the string; the armies especially feared them.
translations.idiomatic: There were also Western Region men skilled with bow and arrow who never missed the string; the armies especially feared them.

sentences.zh: 及將戰，明徹謂摩訶曰：「若殪此胡，則彼軍奪氣，君有關、張之名，可斬顏良矣。

translations.literal: As they were about to fight, Mingche said to Mohe: "If we kill this barbarian, their army will lose its spirit. You have the fame of Guan and Zhang—you can behead Yan Liang.
translations.idiomatic: As they were about to fight, Mingche told Mohe, "If we kill this barbarian, their army will lose its spirit. You have the fame of Guan and Zhang—you can behead Yan Liang.

sentences.zh: 」摩訶曰：「願示其形狀，當為公取之。

translations.literal: " Mohe said: "I wish to be shown his appearance; I will take him for you.
translations.idiomatic: " Mohe said, "Show me his appearance and I will take him for you."

sentences.zh: 」明徹乃召降人有識胡者，云胡著絳衣，樺皮裝弓，兩端骨弭。

translations.literal: Mingche then summoned a surrendered man who knew the barbarian and was told the barbarian wore crimson clothes, a birch-bark bow case, and bone nocks at both ends.
translations.idiomatic: Mingche then summoned a surrendered man who knew the barbarian and was told he wore crimson clothes, a birch-bark bow case, and bone nocks at both ends.

sentences.zh: 明徹遣人覘伺，知胡在陣，乃自酌酒以飲摩訶。

translations.literal: Mingche sent men to spy and learned the barbarian was in the formation; he then poured wine himself for Mohe to drink.
translations.idiomatic: Mingche sent men to spy and learned the barbarian was in the formation; he then poured wine himself for Mohe to drink.

sentences.zh: 摩訶飲訖，馳馬衝齊軍，胡挺身出陣前十餘步，彀弓未發，摩訶遙擲銑鋧，正中其額，應手而仆。

translations.literal: When Mohe had finished drinking he galloped and charged the Qi army; the barbarian stepped forward more than ten paces before the formation, drew his bow but had not yet loosed, when Mohe from afar hurled an iron club that struck him square on the forehead and he fell at once.
translations.idiomatic: When Mohe had finished drinking he galloped and charged the Qi army. The barbarian stepped forward more than ten paces before the formation and drew his bow but had not yet loosed when Mohe from afar hurled an iron club that struck him square on the forehead and he fell at once.

sentences.zh: 齊軍「大力」十餘人出戰，摩訶又斬之，於是齊軍退走。

translations.literal: More than ten men of the Qi "Great-Strength" unit came out to fight; Mohe cut them down as well, and the Qi army then retreated.
translations.idiomatic: More than ten men of the Qi Great-Strength unit came out to fight; Mohe cut them down as well, and the Qi army then retreated.

sentences.zh: 以功授明毅將軍、員外散騎常侍，封廉平縣伯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: For his merit he was made Bright-Resolution General and Extraordinary Scattered-Cavalry Regular Attendant, enfeoffed as Baron of Lianping, fief five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was made bright-resolution general and extraordinary scattered-cavalry regular attendant, enfeoffed as Baron of Lianping, fief five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 尋進爵為侯，轉太僕卿，餘如故。

translations.literal: Soon his title was advanced to Marquis; he was moved to Grand Master of the Stud, the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: Soon his title was advanced to marquis; he was moved to grand master of the stud, the rest as before.

sentences.zh: 七年，又隨明徹進圍宿預，擊走齊將王康德，以功除晉熙太守。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he again followed Mingche in investing Suyu, routed the Qi general Wang Kande, and for his merit was made Administrator of Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 he again followed Mingche in investing Suyu, routed the Qi general Wang Kande, and for his merit was made administrator of Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 九年，明徹進軍呂梁，與齊人大戰，摩訶率七騎先入，手奪齊軍大旗，齊眾大潰。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Mingche advanced on Lüliang and fought a great battle with the Qi; Mohe led seven horsemen in first, seized the Qi army's great banner with his own hand, and the Qi host was utterly routed.
translations.idiomatic: In year 9 Mingche advanced on Lüliang and fought a great battle with Qi. Mohe led seven horsemen in first, seized the Qi army's great banner with his own hand, and the Qi host was utterly routed.

sentences.zh: 以功授持節、武毅將軍、譙州刺史。

translations.literal: For his merit he was made Bearer of the Staff, Martial-Resolution General, and Inspector of Qiao.
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was made bearer of the staff, martial-resolution general, and inspector of Qiao.

sentences.zh: 及周武帝滅齊，遣其將宇文忻率眾爭呂梁，戰於龍晦。

translations.literal: When Zhou Emperor Wu destroyed Qi, he sent his general Yuwen Xin with troops to contest Lüliang; they fought at Longhui.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou Emperor Wu destroyed Qi, he sent his general Yuwen Xin with troops to contest Lüliang; they fought at Longhui.

sentences.zh: 時忻有精騎數千，摩訶領十二騎深入周軍，縱橫奮擊，斬馘甚眾。

translations.literal: At that time Xin had several thousand picked horsemen; Mohe led twelve riders deep into the Zhou army, charging and slashing in every direction, and beheaded and counted heads in great number.
translations.idiomatic: Xin then had several thousand picked horsemen; Mohe led twelve riders deep into the Zhou army, charging and slashing in every direction, and beheaded and counted heads in great number.

sentences.zh: 及周遣大將軍王軌來赴，結長圍連鎖於呂梁下流，斷大軍還路。

translations.literal: When Zhou sent the great general Wang Gui to hurry to the scene, he formed a long encirclement and chained the river at Lüliang downstream, cutting off the great army's route of return.
translations.idiomatic: When Zhou sent the great general Wang Gui to hurry to the scene, he formed a long encirclement and chained the river at Lüliang downstream, cutting off the great army's route of return.

sentences.zh: 摩訶謂明徹曰：「聞王軌始鎖下流，其兩頭築城，今尚未立，公若見遣擊之，彼必不敢相拒。

translations.literal: Mohe said to Mingche: "I hear Wang Gui has only begun to chain the downstream—at both ends he is building forts, and they are not yet finished. If you send us to attack, they surely will not dare resist.
translations.idiomatic: Mohe told Mingche, "I hear Wang Gui has only begun to chain the downstream—at both ends he is building forts, and they are not yet finished. If you send us to attack, they surely will not dare resist.

sentences.zh: 水路未斷，賊勢不堅，彼城若立，則吾屬且為虜矣。

translations.literal: The water route is not yet cut; the enemy's position is not firm. If those forts are built, then we shall be captives.
translations.idiomatic: The water route is not yet cut; the enemy's position is not firm. If those forts are built, then we shall be captives."

sentences.zh: 」明徹乃奮髯曰；

translations.literal: Mingche then stroked his beard and said:
translations.idiomatic: Mingche then stroked his beard and said,

sentences.zh: 「搴旗陷陣，將軍事也；

translations.literal: "Seizing banners and storming formations—that is the general's affair;
translations.idiomatic: "Seizing banners and storming formations—that is the general's affair;

sentences.zh: 長筭遠略，老夫事也。

translations.literal: long calculation and far-reaching design—that is this old man's affair.
translations.idiomatic: long calculation and far-reaching design—that is this old man's affair."

sentences.zh: 」摩訶失色而退。

translations.literal: Mohe turned pale and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Mohe turned pale and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 一旬之間，周兵益至，摩訶又請於明徹曰：「今求戰不得，進退無路，若潛軍突圍，未足為恥。

translations.literal: Within ten days Zhou troops increased further; Mohe again petitioned Mingche: "Now we cannot obtain battle; advance and retreat have no road. If we slip the army through in a breakout, it is not too great a shame.
translations.idiomatic: Within ten days Zhou troops increased further. Mohe again petitioned Mingche, "Now we cannot obtain battle; advance and retreat have no road. If we slip the army through in a breakout, it is not too great a shame.

sentences.zh: 願公率步卒，乘馬轝徐行，摩訶領鐵騎數千，驅馳前後，必當使公安達京邑。

translations.literal: I ask that you lead the foot soldiers, riding in the litter at an easy pace; Mohe will lead several thousand iron cavalry, driving before and behind, and will surely see you safely reach the capital.
translations.idiomatic: I ask that you lead the foot soldiers, riding in the litter at an easy pace; I will lead several thousand iron cavalry, driving before and behind, and will surely see you safely reach the capital."

sentences.zh: 」明徹曰：「弟之此計，乃良圖也。

translations.literal: Mingche said: "Your plan, younger brother, is a fine design.
translations.idiomatic: Mingche said, "Your plan, younger brother, is a fine design.

sentences.zh: 然老夫受脤專征，不能戰勝攻取，今被圍逼蹙，慚寘無地。

translations.literal: Yet this old man received the sacrificial flesh and held sole command on campaign; I could not win in attack or seize in assault. Now besieged and pressed tight, I have no place to set my shame.
translations.idiomatic: Yet this old man received the sacrificial flesh and held sole command on campaign; I could not win in attack or seize in assault. Now besieged and pressed tight, I have no place to set my shame.

sentences.zh: 且步軍既多，吾為總督，必須身居其後，相率兼行。

translations.literal: Moreover the foot troops are many; as overall commander I must myself remain at their rear and lead them all together.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the foot troops are many; as overall commander I must myself remain at their rear and lead them all together.

sentences.zh: 弟馬軍宜須在前，不可遲緩。

translations.literal: Your cavalry, younger brother, must be in front and cannot delay.
translations.idiomatic: Your cavalry, younger brother, must be in front and cannot delay."

sentences.zh: 」摩訶因率馬軍夜發。

translations.literal: Mohe thereupon led the cavalry out by night.
translations.idiomatic: Mohe thereupon led the cavalry out by night.

sentences.zh: 先是，周軍長圍既合，又於要路下伏數重，摩訶選精騎八十，率先衝突，自後眾騎繼焉，比旦達淮南。

translations.literal: Earlier, when the Zhou long encirclement had closed, they also laid ambushes in several tiers on the critical roads; Mohe chose eighty picked riders to charge first, with the rest of the horsemen following behind; by dawn they reached Huainan.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, when the Zhou long encirclement had closed, they also laid ambushes in several tiers on the critical roads. Mohe chose eighty picked riders to charge first, with the rest of the horsemen following behind; by dawn they reached Huainan.

sentences.zh: 高宗詔徵還，授右衛將軍。

translations.literal: Emperor Xuan issued an edict summoning him back and made him General of the Right Guard.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Xuan issued an edict summoning him back and made him general of the right guard.

sentences.zh: 十一年，周兵寇壽陽，摩訶與樊毅等眾軍赴援，無功而還。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Zhou troops raided Shouyang; Mohe with Fan Yi and the mass of armies went to relieve them, achieved nothing, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Zhou troops raided Shouyang; Mohe with Fan Yi and the mass of armies went to relieve them, achieved nothing, and returned.

sentences.zh: 十四年，高宗崩，始興王叔陵於殿內手刃後主，傷而不死，叔陵奔東府城。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Emperor Xuan died; the Prince of Shixing, Shuling, in the hall drew a blade on Houzhu, wounding but not killing him, and Shuling fled to the Eastern Mansion city.
translations.idiomatic: In year 14 Emperor Xuan died; Prince Shuling of Shixing drew a blade on Houzhu in the hall, wounding but not killing him, and Shuling fled to the Eastern Mansion city.

sentences.zh: 時眾心猶預，莫有討賊者，東宮舍人司馬申啟後主，馳召摩訶，入見受敕，乃率馬步數百，先趣東府城西門屯軍。

translations.literal: At that time popular sentiment was still unsettled and none moved to punish the traitor; Eastern Palace Attendant Sima Shen reported to Houzhu and galloped to summon Mohe. On entering audience he received the command, then led several hundred horse and foot and first hurried to the Western Gate of the Eastern Mansion to encamp his troops.
translations.idiomatic: At that time popular sentiment was still unsettled and none moved to punish the traitor. Eastern palace attendant Sima Shen reported to Houzhu and galloped to summon Mohe. On entering audience he received the command, then led several hundred horse and foot and first hurried to the western gate of the Eastern Mansion to encamp his troops.

sentences.zh: 叔陵惶遽，自城南門而出，摩訶勒兵追斬之。

translations.literal: Shuling in panic went out from the southern gate; Mohe reined his troops in pursuit and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Shuling in panic went out from the southern gate; Mohe reined his troops in pursuit and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 以功授散騎常侍、車騎大將軍〔二〕，封綏

translations.literal: For his merit he was made Scattered-Cavalry Regular Attendant and General of Chariots and Cavalry, Editorial footnote marker 2. enfeoffed as Sui
translations.idiomatic: For his merit he was made scattered-cavalry regular attendant and general of chariots and cavalry [2], enfeoffed as Sui

translations.literal: Collation variant: (yuan).
translations.idiomatic: Collation variant: (yuan).

sentences.zh: 〔建〕郡公，〔三〕邑三千戶。

translations.literal: [jian] Commandery Duke, Editorial footnote marker 3. fief three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: (jian) Commandery Duke, [3] with a fief of three thousand households.

sentences.zh: 叔陵素所蓄聚金帛累巨萬，後主悉以賜之。

translations.literal: The gold and silks Shuling had long amassed amounted to tens of millions; Houzhu gave them all to him.
translations.idiomatic: The gold and silks Shuling had long amassed amounted to tens of millions; Houzhu gave them all to him.

sentences.zh: 尋改授侍中、驃騎大將軍，〔四〕加左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: Soon he was moved to Palace Attendant and Grand General of Agile Cavalry, Editorial footnote marker 4. with the additional post of Left Grand Master of the Palace.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was moved to palace attendant and grand general of agile cavalry [4], with the additional post of left grand master of the palace.

sentences.zh: 舊制三公黃閤聽事置鴟尾，後主特賜摩訶開黃閤，門施行馬，聽事寢堂並置鴟尾。

translations.literal: By old regulation the three dukes' yellow-gate audience halls were furnished with ogre-tail ornaments; Houzhu specially granted Mohe an opened yellow gate, a gate with traveling horses, and ogre-tail ornaments in both audience hall and sleeping hall.
translations.idiomatic: By old regulation the three dukes' yellow-gate audience halls were furnished with ogre-tail ornaments; Houzhu specially granted Mohe an opened yellow gate, a gate with traveling horses, and ogre-tail ornaments in both audience hall and sleeping hall.

sentences.zh: 仍以其女為皇太子妃。

translations.literal: He also made Mohe's daughter crown prince consort.
translations.idiomatic: He also made Mohe's daughter crown prince consort.

sentences.zh: 會隋總管賀若弼鎮廣陵，窺覦江左，後主委摩訶備禦之任，授南徐州刺史，餘並如故。

translations.literal: It happened that Sui Area Commander He Ruo Bi was stationed at Guangling, watching the lands south of the Yangzi; Houzhu entrusted Mohe with the duty of defense and made him Inspector of South Xuzhou, the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Sui area commander He Ruo Bi was stationed at Guangling, watching the lands south of the Yangzi; Houzhu entrusted Mohe with the duty of defense and made him inspector of South Xuzhou, the rest as before.

sentences.zh: 禎明三年正月元會，徵摩訶還朝，賀若弼乘虛濟江，襲京口，摩訶請兵逆戰，後主不許。

translations.literal: In the first month of Zhenming year 3, at the New Year's audience, Mohe was summoned back to court; He Ruo Bi seized the opening, crossed the river, and stormed Jingkou. Mohe asked for troops to meet him in battle; Houzhu would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Zhenming year 3 (587), at the New Year's audience, Mohe was summoned back to court; He Ruo Bi seized the opening, crossed the river, and stormed Jingkou. Mohe asked for troops to meet him in battle; Houzhu would not permit it.

sentences.zh: 及

translations.literal: When
translations.idiomatic: When

translations.literal: Collation variant: (Ruo).
translations.idiomatic: Collation variant: (Ruo).

sentences.zh: 弼進軍鍾山〔五〕，摩訶又請曰「賀若弼懸軍深入，聲援猶遠，且其壘塹未堅，人情惶懼，出兵掩襲，必大克之」，後主又不許。

translations.literal: Bi advanced on Bell Mountain, Editorial footnote marker 5. Mohe again petitioned: "He Ruo Bi has hung his army deep in enemy country; his sound support is still far, and his ramparts and trenches are not yet firm; men's hearts are fearful. If we send troops in a masked strike, we are sure to win greatly"—Houzhu again would not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: Bi advanced on Bell Mountain [5], Mohe again petitioned, "He Ruo Bi has hung his army deep in enemy country; his sound support is still far, and his ramparts and trenches are not yet firm; men's hearts are fearful. If we send troops in a masked strike, we are sure to win greatly"—Houzhu again would not permit it.

sentences.zh: 及隋軍大至，將出戰，後主謂摩訶曰：「公可為我一決。

translations.literal: When the Sui army came in great force and they were about to go out to battle, Houzhu said to Mohe: "You can settle this for me in one stroke.
translations.idiomatic: When the Sui army came in great force and they were about to go out to battle, Houzhu told Mohe, "You can settle this for me in one stroke.

sentences.zh: 」摩訶曰：「從來行陣，為國為身，今日之事，兼為妻子。

translations.literal: " Mohe said: "In every campaign until now it has been for the state and for myself; in today's affair it is for the state, for myself, and for wife and children.
translations.idiomatic: " Mohe said, "In every campaign until now it has been for the state and for myself; in today's affair it is for the state, for myself, and for wife and children."

sentences.zh: 」後主多出金帛，頒賞諸軍，令中領軍魯廣達陳兵白土崗，居眾軍之南偏，鎮東大將軍任忠次之，護軍將軍樊毅、都官尚書孔範次之，摩訶軍最居北，眾軍南北亙二十里，首尾進退，各不相知。

translations.literal: Houzhu brought out much gold and silk and distributed rewards through the armies, ordering Central Army Commander Lu Guangda to array troops at White Earth Mound on the southern flank of the mass of armies; Pacify-the-East Grand General Ren Zhong was next; Protector of the Army General Fan Yi and Minister of State Affairs Kong Fan were after them; Mohe's army was farthest north. The armies stretched twenty li north and south; advance and retreat at either end, each did not know the other.
translations.idiomatic: Houzhu brought out much gold and silk and distributed rewards through the armies, ordering central army commander Lu Guangda to array troops at White Earth Mound on the southern flank of the mass of armies; pacify-the-east grand general Ren Zhong was next; protector of the army general Fan Yi and minister of state affairs Kong Fan were after them; Mohe's army was farthest north. The armies stretched twenty li north and south; advance and retreat at either end, each did not know the other.

sentences.zh: 賀若弼初謂未戰，將輕騎，登山觀望形勢，及見眾軍，因馳下置陣。

translations.literal: He Ruo Bi at first thought there would be no battle and was about to take light horsemen up the mountain to observe the situation; when he saw the mass of armies he galloped down and set his formation.
translations.idiomatic: He Ruo Bi at first thought there would be no battle and was about to take light horsemen up the mountain to observe the situation; when he saw the mass of armies he galloped down and set his formation.

sentences.zh: 廣達首率所部進薄，弼軍屢卻，俄而復振，更分軍趣北突諸將，孔範出戰，兵交而走，諸將支離，陣猶未合，騎卒潰散，駐之弗止，摩訶無所用力焉，為隋軍所執。

translations.literal: Guangda first led his division in pressing close; Bi's army repeatedly fell back, then soon rallied again and further divided troops to strike north and break through the generals. Kong Fan went out to fight; when the armies met he fled. The generals were scattered; the formation was not yet joined when the cavalry broke and ran—halting them would not stop them. Mohe had no place to exert his strength and was seized by the Sui army.
translations.idiomatic: Guangda first led his division in pressing close; Bi's army repeatedly fell back, then soon rallied again and further divided troops to strike north and break through the generals. Kong Fan went out to fight; when the armies met he fled. The generals were scattered; the formation was not yet joined when the cavalry broke and ran—halting them would not stop them. Mohe had no place to exert his strength and was seized by the Sui army.

sentences.zh: 及京城陷，賀若弼置後主於德教殿，令兵衛守，摩訶請弼曰：「 今為囚虜，命在斯須，願得一見舊主，死無所恨。

translations.literal: When the capital fell, He Ruo Bi placed Houzhu in the Hall of Virtuous Teaching and set soldiers to guard him. Mohe asked Bi: "Now I am a captive and my life hangs on an instant; I wish to see my former lord once—then to die would be without regret.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital fell, He Ruo Bi placed Houzhu in the Hall of Virtuous Teaching and set soldiers to guard him. Mohe asked Bi, "Now I am a captive and my life hangs on an instant; I wish to see my former lord once—then to die would be without regret.

sentences.zh: 」弼哀而許之。

translations.literal: " Bi pitied him and granted it.
translations.idiomatic: " Bi pitied him and granted it.

sentences.zh: 摩訶入見後主，俯伏號泣，仍於舊廚取食而進之，辭訣而出，守衛者皆不能仰視。

translations.literal: Mohe entered to see Houzhu, prostrated himself and wept aloud, then from the old kitchen took food and presented it; when he took his leave the guards could not raise their eyes to look.
translations.idiomatic: Mohe entered to see Houzhu, prostrated himself and wept aloud, then from the old kitchen took food and presented it; when he took his leave the guards could not raise their eyes to look.

sentences.zh: 其年入隋，授開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: That year he entered Sui and was made Founder of a Bureau and Equal in Protocol to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: That year he entered Sui and was made founder of a bureau and equal in protocol to the three excellencies.

sentences.zh: 尋從漢王諒詣并州，同諒作逆，伏誅，時年七十三。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Han Prince Liang to Bingzhou and joined him in rebellion; he was executed by beheading, aged seventy-three.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he followed Han Prince Liang to Bingzhou and joined him in rebellion; he was executed by beheading, aged seventy-three.

sentences.zh: 摩訶訥於語言，恂恂長者，至於臨戎對寇，志氣奮發，所向無前。

translations.literal: Mohe was slow of speech and deferential like an elder; yet when facing the enemy on campaign his spirit blazed and wherever he aimed none stood before him.
translations.idiomatic: Mohe was slow of speech and deferential like an elder; yet when facing the enemy on campaign his spirit blazed and wherever he aimed none stood before him.

sentences.zh: 年未弱冠，隨侯安都在京口，性好射獵，無日不畋遊。

translations.literal: Before he had reached the capping age he followed Hou Andu at Jingkou and loved shooting and hunting; not a day passed without hunting.
translations.idiomatic: Before he had reached the capping age he followed Hou Andu at Jingkou and loved shooting and hunting; not a day passed without hunting.

sentences.zh: 及安都東征西伐，戰勝攻取，摩訶功寔居多。

translations.literal: When Andu campaigned east and west, winning in attack and seizing in assault, Mohe's merit was in truth the greater part.
translations.idiomatic: When Andu campaigned east and west, winning in attack and seizing in assault, Mohe's merit was in truth the greater part.

sentences.zh: 子世廉，少警俊，敢勇有父風。

translations.literal: His son Shilian in youth was alert and outstanding, daring and brave with his father's manner.
translations.idiomatic: His son Shilian in youth was alert and outstanding, daring and brave with his father's manner.

sentences.zh: 性至孝，及摩訶凶終，服闋後，追慕彌切。

translations.literal: His nature was utmost in filial piety; when Mohe met his violent end and mourning was finished, his longing grew still keener.
translations.idiomatic: His nature was utmost in filial piety; when Mohe met his violent end and mourning was finished, his longing grew still keener.

sentences.zh: 其父時賓故脫有所言及，世廉對之，哀慟不自勝，言者為之歔欷。

translations.literal: When his father's former guests happened to speak of him, Shilian would answer them, grieving beyond bearing himself, and those who spoke would sigh for him.
translations.idiomatic: When his father's former guests happened to speak of him, Shilian would answer them, grieving beyond bearing himself, and those who spoke would sigh for him.

sentences.zh: 終身不執刀斧，時人嘉焉。

translations.literal: All his life he would not take up knife or axe; men of the time praised him.
translations.idiomatic: All his life he would not take up knife or axe; men of the time praised him.

sentences.zh: 摩訶有騎士陳智深者，勇力過人，以平叔陵之功，為巴陵內史。

translations.literal: Mohe had a rider Chen Zhishen whose courage and strength surpassed others; for merit in pacifying Shuling he was made Inner Administrator of Baling.
translations.idiomatic: Mohe had a rider Chen Zhishen whose courage and strength surpassed others; for merit in pacifying Shuling he was made inner administrator of Baling.

sentences.zh: 摩訶之戮也，其妻子先已籍沒，智深收摩訶屍，手自殯斂，哀感行路，君子義之。

translations.literal: When Mohe was executed, his wife and children had already been registered and confiscated; Zhishen gathered Mohe's corpse and with his own hands prepared the burial—his grief moved those on the road, and gentlemen honored him.
translations.idiomatic: When Mohe was executed, his wife and children had already been registered and confiscated; Zhishen gathered Mohe's corpse and with his own hands prepared the burial—his grief moved those on the road, and gentlemen honored him.

sentences.zh: 潁川陳禹，亦隨摩訶征討，聰敏有識量，涉獵經史，解風角、兵書，頗能屬文，便騎射，官至王府諮議。

translations.literal: Yingchuan's Chen Yu also followed Mohe on campaigns; he was clever and discerning, ranged through the classics and histories, understood wind-omens and military books, could compose literary pieces, was skilled at mounted archery, and rose to advising officer of the prince's establishment.
translations.idiomatic: Yingchuan's Chen Yu also followed Mohe on campaigns; he was clever and discerning, ranged through the classics and histories, understood wind-omens and military books, could compose literary pieces, was skilled at mounted archery, and rose to advising officer of the prince's establishment.

sentences.zh: 任忠字奉誠，小名蠻奴，汝陰人也。

translations.literal: Ren Zhong, styled Fengcheng, childhood name Mantu, was a native of Ruyin.
translations.idiomatic: Ren Zhong, styled Fengcheng, childhood name Mantu, came from Ruyin.

sentences.zh: 少孤微，不為鄉黨所齒。

translations.literal: In youth he was orphaned and lowly and was not regarded by his village and district.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was orphaned and lowly and was not regarded by his village and district.

sentences.zh: 及長，譎詭多計略，膂力過人，尤善騎射，州里少年皆附之。

translations.literal: When grown he was crafty and full of stratagems, with strength surpassing others, especially skilled at mounted archery; the young men of the commandery all attached to him.
translations.idiomatic: When grown he was crafty and full of stratagems, with strength surpassing others, especially skilled at mounted archery; the young men of the commandery all attached to him.

sentences.zh: 梁鄱陽王蕭範為合州刺史，聞其名，引置左右。

translations.literal: Liang's Prince of Poyang Xiao Fan was Inspector of He, heard his name, and brought him in to his close attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Liang's Prince of Poyang Xiao Fan was inspector of He, heard his name, and brought him in to his close attendants.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，忠率鄉黨數百人，隨晉熙太守梅伯龍討景將王貴顯於壽春，〔六〕每戰卻敵。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion Zhong led several hundred men of his village and followed Jinxi Administrator Mei Bolong in attacking Jing's general Wang Guixian at Shouchun, Editorial footnote marker 6. each battle driving the enemy back.
translations.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion Zhong led several hundred men of his village and followed Jinxi administrator Mei Bolong in attacking Jing's general Wang Guixian at Shouchun [6], each battle driving the enemy back.

sentences.zh: 會土人胡通聚眾寇抄，範命忠與主帥梅思立并軍討平之。

translations.literal: It happened that the local man Hu Tong gathered a host to plunder; Fan ordered Zhong and the chief commander Mei Sili to join armies and pacify them.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that the local man Hu Tong gathered a host to plunder; Fan ordered Zhong and the chief commander Mei Sili to join armies and pacify them.

sentences.zh: 仍隨範世子嗣率眾入援，會京城陷，旋戍晉熙。

translations.literal: He then followed Fan's heir Sili with troops in relief; when the capital fell they turned to garrison Jinxi.
translations.idiomatic: He then followed Fan's heir Sili with troops in relief; when the capital fell they turned to garrison Jinxi.

sentences.zh: 侯景平，授蕩寇將軍。

translations.literal: When Hou Jing was pacified he was made Pacify-the-Raider General.
translations.idiomatic: When Hou Jing was pacified he was made pacify-the-raider general.

sentences.zh: 王琳立蕭莊，署忠為巴陵太守。

translations.literal: Wang Lin established Xiao Zhuang and appointed Zhong Administrator of Baling.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Lin established Xiao Zhuang and appointed Zhong administrator of Baling.

sentences.zh: 琳敗還朝，遷明毅將軍、安湘太守，仍隨侯瑱進討巴、湘。

translations.literal: When Lin was defeated and returned to court, Zhong was moved to Bright-Resolution General and Administrator of Anxiang, and still followed Hou Tian in advancing to attack Ba and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: When Lin was defeated and returned to court, Zhong was moved to bright-resolution general and administrator of Anxiang, and still followed Hou Tian in advancing to attack Ba and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 累遷豫寧太守、衡陽內史。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Administrator of Yuning and Inner Administrator of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly promoted to administrator of Yuning and inner administrator of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 華皎之舉兵也，忠預其謀。

translations.literal: When Hua Jiao raised troops, Zhong took part in his plot.
translations.idiomatic: When Hua Jiao raised troops, Zhong took part in his plot.

sentences.zh: 及皎平，高宗以忠先有密啟於朝廷，釋而不問。

translations.literal: When Jiao was pacified, Emperor Xuan, because Zhong had earlier sent a secret report to the court, released him without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiao was pacified, Emperor Xuan, because Zhong had earlier sent a secret report to the court, released him without inquiry.

sentences.zh: 太建初，隨章昭達討歐陽紇於廣州，以功授直閤將軍。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taijian he followed Zhang Zhaoda in attacking Ouyang He at Guangzhou and for his merit was made Direct Attendant of the Yellow Gate.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taijian he followed Zhang Zhaoda in attacking Ouyang He at Guangzhou and for his merit was made direct attendant of the yellow gate.

sentences.zh: 遷武毅將軍、廬陵內史，秩滿，入為右軍將軍。

translations.literal: He was moved to Martial-Resolution General and Inner Administrator of Luling; when his term ended he entered court as General of the Right Army.
translations.idiomatic: He was moved to martial-resolution general and inner administrator of Luling; when his term ended he entered court as general of the right army.

sentences.zh: 五年，眾軍北伐，忠將兵出西道，擊走齊歷陽王高景安於大峴，逐北至東關，仍克其東西二城。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of the northern campaign of the mass of armies, Zhong led troops on the western route, routed Qi Prince of Liyang Gao Jing'an at Great Xian, pursued north to Dong Pass, and then took its eastern and western cities.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 of the northern campaign of the mass of armies, Zhong led troops on the western route, routed Qi Prince of Liyang Gao Jing'an at Great Xian, pursued north to Dong Pass, and then took its eastern and western cities.

sentences.zh: 進軍蘄、譙，〔七〕並拔之。

translations.literal: Advancing on Qi and Qiao, Editorial footnote marker 7. he took both.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing on Qi and Qiao [7], he took both.

sentences.zh: 徑襲合肥，入其郛。

translations.literal: He struck straight at Hefei and entered its outer wall.
translations.idiomatic: He struck straight at Hefei and entered its outer suburbs.

sentences.zh: 進克霍州。

translations.literal: Advancing, he captured Huo Province.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing, he captured Huo Province.

sentences.zh: 以功授員外散騎常侍，封安復縣侯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: For merit he was made Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and enfeoffed as Marquis of Anfu County with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was made regular attendant of the scattered cavalry and enfeoffed as marquis of Anfu county with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 呂梁之喪師也，忠全軍而還。

translations.literal: When the armies were destroyed at Lüliang, Zhong brought his army back intact.
translations.idiomatic: When the armies were destroyed at Lüliang, Zhong brought his army back intact.

sentences.zh: 尋詔忠都督壽陽、新蔡、霍州緣淮眾軍，進號寧遠將軍、霍州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon an edict made Zhong area commander over the armies along the Huai at Shouyang, Xincai, and Huo; he was promoted to Ningyuan General and Inspector of Huo.
translations.idiomatic: Soon an edict made Zhong commander of the armies along the Huai at Shouyang, Xincai, and Huo; he was promoted to ningyuan general and inspector of Huo.

sentences.zh: 入為左衛將軍。

translations.literal: He entered court as Left Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as left guard general.

sentences.zh: 十一年，加北討前軍事，進號平北將軍，率眾步騎趣秦郡。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was additionally made commander of the northern expedition vanguard, promoted to Pacify-North General, and led infantry and cavalry toward Qin Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was additionally made commander of the northern expedition vanguard, promoted to pacify-north general, and led infantry and cavalry toward Qin commandery.

sentences.zh: 十二年，遷使持節、散騎常侍、都督南豫州諸軍事、平南將軍、南豫州刺史，增邑并前一千五百戶。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was moved to Bearer of the Staff, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Area Commander over Southern Yuzhou military affairs, Pacify-South General, and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou; his fief was increased with the former to one thousand five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made bearer of the staff, regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, commander over Southern Yuzhou military affairs, pacify-south general, and inspector of Southern Yuzhou; his fief was increased with the former to one thousand five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 仍率步騎趣歷陽。

translations.literal: He still led infantry and cavalry toward Liyang.
translations.idiomatic: He still led infantry and cavalry toward Liyang.

sentences.zh: 周遣王延貴率眾為援，忠大破之，生擒延貴。

translations.literal: Northern Zhou sent Wang Yanging leading troops as relief; Zhong inflicted a great defeat and captured Yanging alive.
translations.idiomatic: Northern Zhou sent Wang Yanging with troops in relief; Zhong routed them and captured Yanging alive.

sentences.zh: 後主嗣位，進號鎮南將軍，給鼓吹一部。

translations.literal: When the Later Lord succeeded, Zhong was promoted to Garrison-South General and given one set of pipes and drums.
translations.idiomatic: When Houzhu succeeded, Zhong was promoted to garrison-south general and given one set of pipes and drums.

sentences.zh: 入為領軍將軍，加侍中，改封梁信

translations.literal: He entered court as Commander of the Army, was additionally made Palace Attendant, and was re-enfeoffed as Liangxin
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as commander of the army, was also made palace attendant, and was re-enfeoffed as Liangxin

translations.literal: (Du).
translations.idiomatic: Collation variant: (Du).

sentences.zh: 郡公，〔八〕邑三千戶。

translations.literal: Commandery Duke, Editorial footnote marker 8. fief three thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Commandery Duke [8], with a fief of three thousand households.

sentences.zh: 出為吳興內史，加秩中二千石。

translations.literal: He went out as Interior Minister of Wuxing with rank at two thousand shi of grain.
translations.idiomatic: He went out as interior minister of Wuxing with rank at two thousand shi of grain.

sentences.zh: 及隋兵濟江，忠自吳興入赴，屯軍朱雀門。

translations.literal: When Sui forces crossed the Yangtze, Zhong came in from Wuxing and garrisoned at the Vermilion Bird Gate.
translations.idiomatic: When Sui forces crossed the Yangtze, Zhong came in from Wuxing and garrisoned at the Vermilion Bird Gate.

sentences.zh: 後主召蕭摩訶以下於內殿定議，忠執議曰：「兵家稱客主異勢，客貴速戰，主貴持重。

translations.literal: The Later Lord summoned Xiao Mohe and others to the inner hall for deliberation; Zhong pressed his view, saying: "Military writers say guest and host differ in strength—the guest values swift battle, the host values weight.
translations.idiomatic: Houzhu summoned Xiao Mohe and others to the inner hall for deliberation. Zhong pressed his view: "Writers on war say guest and host differ in strength—the guest should fight swiftly, the host should hold firm.

sentences.zh: 宜且益兵堅守宮城，遣水軍分向南豫州及京口道，斷寇糧運。

translations.literal: For now we should add troops and hold the palace city fast, send the fleet in detachments toward Southern Yuzhou and the Jingkou route, and cut the invaders' grain transport.
translations.idiomatic: We should add troops and hold the palace city, send the fleet in detachments toward Southern Yuzhou and the Jingkou route, and cut the enemy's grain transport.

sentences.zh: 待春水長，上江周羅睺等眾軍，必沿流赴援，此良計矣。

translations.literal: When spring waters rise, the upstream armies under Zhou Luohou and others will surely come downriver in relief—this is the sound plan."
translations.idiomatic: When spring waters rise, the upstream armies under Zhou Luohou and others will surely come downriver in relief. That is the sound plan."

sentences.zh: 」眾議不同，因遂出戰。

translations.literal: The assembly disagreed, and so they went out to battle.
translations.idiomatic: The assembly disagreed, and they went out to battle.

sentences.zh: 及敗，忠馳入臺見後主，言敗狀，啟云：「陛下唯當具舟楫，就上流眾軍，臣以死奉衛。

translations.literal: When defeated, Zhong galloped into the palace to see the Later Lord, reported the defeat, and memorialized: "Your Majesty need only ready boats and go to the upstream armies; your servant will guard you unto death."
translations.idiomatic: When defeated, Zhong galloped into the palace, reported the defeat, and said, "Your Majesty need only ready boats and go to the upstream armies; I will guard you unto death."

sentences.zh: 」後主信之，敕忠出部分，忠辭云：「臣處分訖，即當奉迎。

translations.literal: The Later Lord believed him and ordered Zhong to go out and make dispositions; Zhong declined, saying: "When your servant has finished the arrangements, I shall come to escort you."
translations.idiomatic: Houzhu believed him and ordered Zhong to go out and make dispositions. Zhong declined: "When I have finished the arrangements, I shall come to escort you."

sentences.zh: 」後主令宮人裝束以待忠，久望不至。

translations.literal: The Later Lord had palace women dress and wait for Zhong, but long watched in vain for his coming.
translations.idiomatic: Houzhu had palace women dress and wait for Zhong, but watched in vain for a long time.

sentences.zh: 隋將韓擒虎自新林進軍，忠乃率數騎往石子崗降之，仍引擒虎軍共入南掖門。

translations.literal: Sui General Han Qinhu advanced from Xinlin; Zhong then led several horsemen to Shizi Mound to surrender to him, and led Qinhu's army together through the South Side Gate.
translations.idiomatic: Sui general Han Qinhu advanced from Xinlin; Zhong then led several horsemen to Shizi Mound to surrender, and led Qinhu's army in together through the South Side Gate.

sentences.zh: 臺城陷，其年入長安，隋授開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: When the capital fell, that year he entered Chang'an; Sui appointed him Honored Companion with Protocol Equal to the Three Lords.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital fell, that year he entered Chang'an; Sui made him honored companion with protocol equal to the three lords.

sentences.zh: 卒，時年七十七。

translations.literal: He died at age seventy-seven.
translations.idiomatic: He died at age seventy-seven.

sentences.zh: 子幼武，官至儀同三司。

translations.literal: His son Youwu rose to Honored Companion with Protocol Equal to the Three Lords.
translations.idiomatic: His son Youwu rose to honored companion with protocol equal to the three lords.

sentences.zh: 時有沈客卿者，吳興武康人，性便佞忍酷，為中書舍人，每立異端，唯以刻削百姓為事，由是自進。

translations.literal: At the time there was Shen Keqing, a man of Wukang in Wuxing; by nature crafty, fawning, and cruel, he served as Secretariat Attendant; he always set up odd schemes and made cutting down the common people his sole business, and thereby advanced himself.
translations.idiomatic: At the time there was Shen Keqing of Wukang in Wuxing—crafty, fawning, and cruel. As secretariat attendant he always devised odd schemes and made squeezing the people his sole business, and thereby advanced himself.

sentences.zh: 有施文慶者，吳興烏程人，起自微賤，有吏用，後主拔為主書，遷中書舍人，俄擢為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: There was also Shi Wenqing, a man of Wucheng in Wuxing; rising from the lowest ranks, he had skill in clerical work; the Later Lord pulled him up as chief secretary, moved him to Secretariat Attendant, and soon promoted him to Inspector of Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: There was also Shi Wenqing of Wucheng in Wuxing, who rose from the lowest ranks with skill in clerical work. Houzhu pulled him up as chief secretary, made him secretariat attendant, and soon promoted him to inspector of Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 未及之官，會隋軍來伐，四方州鎮，相繼以聞。

translations.literal: Before he could take up the post, Sui forces came to attack; prefectures and garrisons everywhere reported in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Before he could take up the post, Sui forces came to attack; prefectures and garrisons everywhere reported in succession.

sentences.zh: 文慶、客卿俱掌機密，外有表啟，皆由其呈奏。

translations.literal: Wenqing and Keqing both held confidential power; all outside memorials and reports passed through them for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: Wenqing and Keqing both held confidential power; all outside memorials and reports passed through them for presentation.

sentences.zh: 文慶心悅湘州重鎮，冀欲早行，遂與客卿共為表裏，抑而不言，後主弗之知也，遂以無備，至乎敗國，寔二人之罪。

translations.literal: Wenqing was pleased by the weight of Xiangzhou and wished to go early; he and Keqing worked inside and outside together, suppressing reports and saying nothing, and the Later Lord did not know—thus through lack of preparation the state was lost; truly the crime of these two men.
translations.idiomatic: Wenqing coveted the weight of Xiangzhou and wished to go early; he and Keqing worked in concert, suppressing reports, and Houzhu knew nothing—through lack of preparation the state was lost; truly these two were to blame.

sentences.zh: 隋軍既入，並戮之於前闕。

translations.literal: When Sui forces had entered, both were executed before the front gate.
translations.idiomatic: When Sui forces entered, both were executed before the front gate.

sentences.zh: 樊毅字智烈，南陽湖陽人也。

translations.literal: Fan Yi, styled Zhilie, was a man of Huyang in Nanyang.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Yi, styled Zhilie, was from Huyang in Nanyang.

sentences.zh: 祖方興，梁散騎常侍、仁威將軍、司州刺史，魚復縣侯。

translations.literal: His grandfather Fangxing was Liang's Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Benevolent Might General, Inspector of Sizhou, and Marquis of Yufu County.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Fangxing was Liang's regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, benevolent might general, inspector of Sizhou, and marquis of Yufu county.

sentences.zh: 父文熾，梁散騎常侍、信武將軍、益州刺史，新蔡縣侯。

translations.literal: His father Wenci was Liang's Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Trustworthy Martial General, Inspector of Yizhou, and Marquis of Xincai County.
translations.idiomatic: His father Wenci was Liang's regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, trustworthy martial general, inspector of Yizhou, and marquis of Xincai county.

sentences.zh: 毅累葉將門，少習武善射。

translations.literal: Yi came from many generations of a general house; in youth he practiced arms and was skilled at archery.
translations.idiomatic: Yi came from many generations of a general house; in youth he practiced arms and was skilled at archery.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，毅率部曲隨叔父文皎援臺。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion Yi led his private troops following his uncle Wenjiao to relieve the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion Yi led his private troops following his uncle Wenjiao to relieve the capital.

sentences.zh: 文皎於青溪戰歿，毅將宗族子弟赴江陵，仍隸王僧辯，討河東王蕭譽，以功除假節、威戎將軍、右中郎將。

translations.literal: Wenjiao died in battle at Qingxi; Yi led clan youths to Jiangling and then attached to Wang Sengbian, campaigning against the Prince of Hedong Xiao Yu; for merit he was made Acting Commander, Might-of-Armies General, and Right Central Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: Wenjiao died in battle at Qingxi; Yi led clan youths to Jiangling and attached to Wang Sengbian in the campaign against the Prince of Hedong Xiao Yu. For merit he was made acting commander, might-of-armies general, and right central commandant.

sentences.zh: 代兄俊為梁興太守，領三州遊軍，隨宜豐侯蕭循討陸納於湘州。

translations.literal: He replaced his elder brother Jun as Administrator of Liangxing, commanded roaming troops of three provinces, and followed the Marquis of Yifeng Xiao Xun to campaign against Lu Na in Xiangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He replaced his elder brother Jun as administrator of Liangxing, commanded roaming troops of three provinces, and followed the Marquis of Yifeng Xiao Xun against Lu Na in Xiangzhou.

sentences.zh: 軍次巴陵，營頓未立，納潛軍夜至，薄營大譟，營中將士皆驚擾，毅獨與左右數十人，當營門力戰，斬十餘級，擊鼓申命，眾乃定焉。

translations.literal: When the army halted at Baling the camp was not yet set; Na sent troops by night, pressed the camp with great clamor, and officers and men in camp were all alarmed; Yi alone with several dozen men on his left and right held the camp gate and fought hard, beheading more than ten heads, beat the drum to proclaim orders, and the host was then settled.
translations.idiomatic: When the army halted at Baling the camp was not yet set. Na sent troops by night, pressed the camp with a great clamor, and the men were alarmed. Yi alone with several dozen men held the camp gate and fought hard, beheading more than ten, beat the drum to proclaim orders, and the host was then settled.

sentences.zh: 以功授持節、通直散騎常侍、貞威將軍，封夷道縣伯，食邑三百戶。

translations.literal: For merit he was made Bearer of the Staff, Direct and Upright Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, and Upright Might General, enfeoffed as Baron of Yidao County with a fief of three hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was made bearer of the staff, direct and upright attendant of the scattered cavalry, and upright might general, enfeoffed as baron of Yidao county with a fief of three hundred households.

sentences.zh: 尋除天門太守，進爵為侯，增邑并前一千戶。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Administrator of Tianmen, advanced in rank to Marquis, and his fief was increased with the former to one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made administrator of Tianmen, advanced to marquis, and his fief was increased with the former to one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 及西魏圍江陵，毅率兵赴援，會江陵陷，為岳陽王所執，久之遁歸。

translations.literal: When Western Wei besieged Jiangling, Yi led troops to relieve it; Jiangling fell and he was seized by the Prince of Yueyang; after a long while he escaped and returned.
translations.idiomatic: When Western Wei besieged Jiangling, Yi led troops to relieve it. Jiangling fell and he was seized by the Prince of Yueyang; after a long while he escaped and returned.

sentences.zh: 高祖受禪，毅與弟猛舉兵應王琳，琳敗奔齊，太尉侯瑱遣使招毅，毅率子弟部曲還朝。

translations.literal: When the High Emperor received the abdication, Yi and his younger brother Meng raised troops in response to Wang Lin; Lin was defeated and fled to Qi; Grand Marshal Hou Tian sent envoys to summon Yi; Yi led sons, nephews, and private troops back to court.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Emperor received the abdication, Yi and his younger brother Meng raised troops for Wang Lin. Lin was defeated and fled to Qi; grand marshal Hou Tian sent envoys to summon Yi, and Yi led sons, nephews, and private troops back to court.

sentences.zh: 天嘉二年，授通直散騎常侍，仍隨侯瑱進討巴、湘。

translations.literal: In the second year of Tiankang he was made Direct and Upright Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and still followed Hou Tian in the advance against Ba and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiankang year 2 he was made direct and upright attendant of the scattered cavalry and still followed Hou Tian against Ba and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 累遷武州刺史。

translations.literal: By successive promotions he became Inspector of Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: By successive promotions he became inspector of Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 太建初，轉豐州刺史，封高昌縣侯，邑一千戶。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taikian he was moved to Inspector of Fengzhou, enfeoffed as Marquis of Gaochang County with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taikian he was moved to inspector of Fengzhou and enfeoffed as marquis of Gaochang county with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 入為左衛將軍。

translations.literal: He entered court as Left Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as left guard general.

sentences.zh: 五年，眾軍北伐，毅率眾攻廣陵楚子城，拔之，擊走齊軍於潁口，齊援滄陵，又破之，七年，進克潼州、下邳、高柵等六城。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of the great northern expedition Yi led troops to attack Chuzi Fort at Guangling, took it, drove off Qi forces at the mouth of the Ying, Qi relief came to Cangling and was again defeated; in the seventh year he advanced and captured Tongzhou, Xiapi, Gaozha, and six other cities.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 of the great northern expedition Yi led troops against Chuzi Fort at Guangling and took it, drove off Qi forces at the mouth of the Ying, and when Qi relief came to Cangling defeated it again. In year 7 he advanced and captured Tongzhou, Xiapi, Gaozha, and six other cities.

sentences.zh: 及呂梁喪師，詔以毅為大都督，進號平北將軍，率眾渡淮，對清口築城，與周人相抗，霖雨城壞，毅全軍自拔。

translations.literal: When Lüliang lost its armies, an edict made Yi supreme commander, promoted him to Pacify-North General, led troops across the Huai, built a fort opposite Qingkou to resist the Zhou, rain in torrents ruined the wall, and Yi brought the whole army out intact.
translations.idiomatic: When Lüliang lost its armies, an edict made Yi supreme commander and promoted him to pacify-north general. He led troops across the Huai, built a fort opposite Qingkou to resist Zhou, torrential rain ruined the wall, and Yi brought the whole army out intact.

sentences.zh: 尋遷中領軍。

translations.literal: Soon he was moved to Central Army Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was moved to central army commander.

sentences.zh: 十一年，周將梁士彥將兵圍壽陽，詔以毅為都督北討前軍事，〔九〕率水軍入焦湖。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Zhou General Liang Shiyan led troops to besiege Shouyang; an edict made Yi commander of the northern expedition vanguard, Editorial footnote marker 9. and he led the fleet into Jiao Lake.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year Zhou general Liang Shiyan led troops to besiege Shouyang; an edict made Yi commander of the northern expedition vanguard [9], and he led the fleet into Jiao Lake.

sentences.zh: 尋授鎮西將軍、都督荊郢巴武四州水陸諸軍事。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Garrison-West General and Area Commander over the land and water forces of the four provinces Jing, Ying, Ba, and Wu.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made garrison-west general and commander over the land and water forces of Jing, Ying, Ba, and Wu.

sentences.zh: 十二年，進督沔、漢諸軍事，以公事免。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was advanced to command the armies of Mian and Han; he was dismissed for a public matter.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was advanced to command the armies of Mian and Han and was dismissed for a public matter.

sentences.zh: 十三年，徵授中護軍。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he was summoned and made Central Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he was summoned and made central protector of the army.

sentences.zh: 尋遷護軍將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was moved to Protector General and Inspector of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was moved to protector general and inspector of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 後主即位，進號征西將軍，改封逍遙郡公，邑三千戶，餘並如故。

translations.literal: When the Later Lord took the throne, Yi was promoted to Campaign-West General, re-enfeoffed as Duke of Xiaoyao Commandery with a fief of three thousand households, the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: When Houzhu took the throne, Yi was promoted to campaign-west general, re-enfeoffed as duke of Xiaoyao commandery with a fief of three thousand households, other offices unchanged.

sentences.zh: 入為侍中、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: He entered court as Palace Attendant and Protector General.
translations.idiomatic: He entered court as palace attendant and protector general.

sentences.zh: 及隋兵濟江，毅謂僕射袁憲曰：「京口、採石，俱是要所，各須銳卒數千，金翅二百，都下江中，上下防捍。

translations.literal: When Sui forces crossed the Yangtze, Yi said to Secretariat Director Yuan Xian: "Jingkou and Caishi are both vital points; each needs several thousand elite troops and two hundred golden-wing [ships] to patrol the river above and below the capital for defense.
translations.idiomatic: When Sui forces crossed the Yangtze, Yi said to secretariat director Yuan Xian, "Jingkou and Caishi are both vital points; each needs several thousand elite troops and two hundred golden-wing ships to patrol the river above and below the capital.

sentences.zh: 如其不然，大事去矣。

translations.literal: If not, the great affair is lost."
translations.idiomatic: If not, the great affair is lost."

sentences.zh: 」諸將咸從其議。

translations.literal: The generals all followed his plan.
translations.idiomatic: The generals all followed his plan.

sentences.zh: 會施文慶等寢隋兵消息，毅計不行。

translations.literal: But Shi Wenqing and others suppressed news of Sui troops, and Yi's plan was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: But Shi Wenqing and others suppressed news of Sui troops, and Yi's plan was not carried out.

sentences.zh: 京城陷，隨例入關，頃之卒。

translations.literal: When the capital fell, he entered the Pass according to precedent; soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital fell, he entered the Pass according to precedent; soon he died.

sentences.zh: 猛字智武，毅之弟也。

translations.literal: Meng, styled Zhiwu, was Yi's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Meng, styled Zhiwu, was Yi's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 幼俶儻，有幹略。

translations.literal: In youth he was bold and unconventional and had capacity and stratagem.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was bold and unconventional, with capacity and stratagem.

sentences.zh: 既壯，便弓馬，膽氣過人。

translations.literal: When grown he was skilled at bow and horse and his daring surpassed others.
translations.idiomatic: When grown he was skilled at bow and horse and his daring surpassed others.

sentences.zh: 青溪之戰，猛自旦訖暮，與虜短兵接，殺傷甚眾。

translations.literal: In the battle at Qingxi, from dawn to dusk Meng fought the enemy at close quarters and killed and wounded very many.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingxi, from dawn to dusk Meng fought the enemy at close quarters and killed and wounded very many.

sentences.zh: 臺城陷，隨兄毅西上京，累戰功為威戎將軍。

translations.literal: When the capital fell he followed his brother Yi west to the western capital; by accumulated battle merit he became Might-of-Armies General.
translations.idiomatic: When the capital fell he followed his brother Yi west to the western capital and by accumulated battle merit became might-of-armies general.

sentences.zh: 梁

translations.literal: Liang
translations.idiomatic: Liang

translations.literal: (An).
translations.idiomatic: Collation variant: (An).

sentences.zh: 南〔安〕侯蕭方矩為湘州刺史，〔一０〕以猛為司馬。

translations.literal: Southern [An] Marquis Xiao Fangju was made Inspector of Xiangzhou, Editorial footnote marker 10. and Meng was made Marshal of the Staff.
translations.idiomatic: Southern [An] marquis Xiao Fangju was made inspector of Xiangzhou [10], and Meng was made marshal of the staff.

sentences.zh: 會武陵王蕭紀舉兵自漢江東下，方矩遣猛率湘、郢之卒，隨都督陸法和進軍以拒之。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Wuling Xiao Ji raised troops from the Han River eastward, Fangju sent Meng to lead the troops of Xiang and Ying, following Area Commander Lu Fahe in an advance to resist him.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Wuling Xiao Ji raised troops from the Han River eastward, Fangju sent Meng to lead the troops of Xiang and Ying, following area commander Lu Fahe to resist him.

sentences.zh: 時紀已下，樓船戰艦據巴江，爭峽口，相持久之，不能決。

translations.literal: At the time Ji had already come downriver; tower ships and war vessels held the Ba River and contested the gorge mouth; they faced each other for a long stalemate and could not decide it.
translations.idiomatic: Ji had already come downriver; tower ships and war vessels held the Ba River and contested the gorge mouth in a long stalemate that could not be decided.

sentences.zh: 法和揣紀師老卒墯，因令猛率驍勇三千，輕舸百餘乘，衝流直上，出其不意，鼓譟薄之。

translations.literal: Fahe judged Ji's army weary and troops slack; he therefore ordered Meng to lead three thousand elite men in more than a hundred light boats upstream straight up, taking him unawares, with drums and clamor pressing close.
translations.idiomatic: Fahe judged Ji's army weary and troops slack and ordered Meng to lead three thousand elite men in more than a hundred light boats straight upstream, taking him unawares with drums and clamor pressing close.

sentences.zh: 紀眾倉卒驚駭，不及整列，皆棄艦登岸，赴水死者以千數。

translations.literal: Ji's host in haste was startled and had no time to form ranks; all abandoned their ships and went ashore, and those who drowned numbered in the thousands.
translations.idiomatic: Ji's host was startled in haste and had no time to form ranks; all abandoned their ships and went ashore, and those who drowned numbered in the thousands.

sentences.zh: 時紀心膂數百人，猶在左右，猛將部曲三十餘人，蒙楯橫戈，直登紀舟，瞋目大呼，紀侍衛皆披靡，相枕藉不敢動。

translations.literal: At the time several hundred of Ji's closest advisers were still at his side; Meng led more than thirty men of his private troops, shielded and spear in hand, straight up onto Ji's boat, glaring and shouting; Ji's attendants all scattered, lying atop one another and not daring to move.
translations.idiomatic: Several hundred of Ji's closest advisers were still at his side. Meng led more than thirty private troops, shields up and spears level, straight onto Ji's boat, glaring and shouting; Ji's attendants scattered, lying atop one another and not daring to move.

sentences.zh: 猛手擒紀父子三人，斬於舟中，盡收其船艦器械。

translations.literal: Meng with his own hand seized Ji and his father and son, three men, and beheaded them in the boat; he gathered all their ships and equipment.
translations.idiomatic: Meng seized Ji and his father and son—three men—and beheaded them in the boat, and gathered all their ships and equipment.

sentences.zh: 以功授游騎將軍，封安山縣伯，邑一千戶。

translations.literal: For merit he was made Roaming-Cavalry General and enfeoffed as Baron of Anshan County with a fief of one thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: For merit he was made roaming-cavalry general and enfeoffed as baron of Anshan county with a fief of one thousand households.

sentences.zh: 仍進軍撫定梁、益，蜀境悉平。

translations.literal: He still advanced to pacify and settle Liang and Yi; the Shu borderlands were all pacified.
translations.idiomatic: He still advanced to pacify Liang and Yi; the Shu borderlands were all pacified.

sentences.zh: 軍還，遷持節、散騎常侍、輕車將軍、司州刺史，進爵為侯，增邑并前二千戶。

translations.literal: When the army returned he was moved to Bearer of the Staff, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Light-Carriage General, and Inspector of Sizhou; he was advanced in rank to Marquis and his fief was increased with the former to two thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned he was made bearer of the staff, regular attendant of the scattered cavalry, light-carriage general, and inspector of Sizhou; he was advanced to marquis and his fief was increased with the former to two thousand households.

sentences.zh: 魯廣達字遍覽，吳州刺史悉達之弟也。

translations.literal: Lu Guangda, styled Bianlan, was the younger brother of Lu Xida, Inspector of Wuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Guangda, styled Bianlan, was the younger brother of Lu Xida, inspector of Wuzhou.

sentences.zh: 少慷慨，志立功名，虛心愛士，賓客或自遠而至。

translations.literal: In youth he was generous and high-minded, resolved to establish merit and fame, open-minded and fond of scholars; guests sometimes came from afar.
translations.idiomatic: In youth he was generous and high-minded, resolved on merit and fame, open-minded and fond of scholars; guests sometimes came from afar.

sentences.zh: 時江表將帥，各領部曲，動以千數，而魯氏尤多。

translations.literal: At the time commanders south of the Yangtze each led private troops, often numbering in the thousands, but the Lu clan had especially many.
translations.idiomatic: At the time commanders south of the Yangtze each led private troops, often in the thousands, but the Lu clan had especially many.

sentences.zh: 釋褐梁邵陵王國右常侍，遷平南當陽公府中兵參軍。

translations.literal: On leaving the purple he was made Right Regular Attendant in the Kingdom of Prince Shaoling of Liang, moved to Central Military Aide in the establishment of the Duke of Dangyang, Pacify-the-South.
translations.idiomatic: On leaving the purple he was made right regular attendant in the kingdom of Prince Shaoling of Liang and moved to central military aide in the establishment of the Duke of Dangyang, pacify-the-south.

sentences.zh: 侯景之亂，與兄悉達聚眾保新蔡。

translations.literal: In Hou Jing's rebellion he and his elder brother Xida gathered troops to hold Xincai.
translations.idiomatic: In Hou Jing's rebellion he and his elder brother Xida gathered troops to hold Xincai.

sentences.zh: 梁元帝承制，授假節、壯武將軍、晉州刺史。

translations.literal: Emperor Yuan of Liang by provisional patent made him Acting Commander, Stalwart Martial General, and Inspector of Jinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yuan of Liang by provisional patent made him acting commander, stalwart martial general, and inspector of Jinzhou.

sentences.zh: 王僧辯之討侯景也，廣達出境候接，資奉軍儲，僧辯謂沈炯曰：「 魯晉州亦是王師東道主人。

translations.literal: When Wang Sengbian campaigned against Hou Jing, Guangda went out of the border to meet and supply the army with provisions; Sengbian said to Shen Jiong: "Lu of Jinzhou is also a host to the royal army on the eastern route.
translations.idiomatic: When Wang Sengbian campaigned against Hou Jing, Guangda went out to meet and supply the army. Sengbian said to Shen Jiong, "Lu of Jinzhou is also a host to the royal army on the eastern route.

sentences.zh: 」仍率眾隨僧辯。

translations.literal: " He then led troops to follow Sengbian.
translations.idiomatic: " He then led troops to follow Sengbian.

sentences.zh: 景平，加員外散騎常侍，餘如故。

translations.literal: When Jing was pacified he was additionally made Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry; the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: When Jing was pacified he was additionally made regular attendant of the scattered cavalry; other offices unchanged.

sentences.zh: 高祖受禪，授征遠將軍、東海太守。

translations.literal: When the High Emperor received the abdication, Guangda was made Campaign-Far General and Administrator of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: When the High Emperor received the abdication, Guangda was made campaign-far general and administrator of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 尋徙為桂陽太守，固辭不拜，入為員外散騎常侍。

translations.literal: Soon he was moved to Administrator of Guiyang; he firmly declined and did not accept, and entered court as Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was moved to administrator of Guiyang; he firmly declined and entered court as regular attendant of the scattered cavalry.

sentences.zh: 除假節、信武將軍、北新蔡太守。

translations.literal: He was made Acting Commander, Trustworthy Martial General, and Administrator of North Xincai.
translations.idiomatic: He was made acting commander, trustworthy martial general, and administrator of North Xincai.

sentences.zh: 隨吳明徹討周迪於臨川，每戰功居最。

translations.literal: Following Wu Mingche in the campaign against Zhou Di at Linchuan, in every battle his merit ranked first.
translations.idiomatic: Following Wu Mingche against Zhou Di at Linchuan, in every battle his merit ranked first.

sentences.zh: 仍代兄悉達為吳州刺史，封中宿縣侯，邑五百戶。

translations.literal: He still replaced his elder brother Xida as Inspector of Wuzhou, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Zhongsu County with a fief of five hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: He still replaced his elder brother Xida as inspector of Wuzhou and was enfeoffed as marquis of Zhongsu county with a fief of five hundred households.

sentences.zh: 光

translations.literal: Guang
translations.idiomatic: Guang

translations.literal: (Lu).
translations.idiomatic: Collation variant: (Lu).

sentences.zh: 大

translations.literal: Grand
translations.idiomatic: Grand

translations.literal: (Master).
translations.idiomatic: Collation variant: (Master).

sentences.zh: 元年，〔一一〕授通直散騎常侍、都督南豫州諸軍事、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: first year, Editorial footnote marker 11. he was made Direct and Upright Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry, Area Commander over Southern Yuzhou military affairs, and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: First year [11] he was made direct and upright attendant of the scattered cavalry, commander over Southern Yuzhou military affairs, and inspector of Southern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 華皎稱兵上流，詔司空淳于量率眾軍進討。

translations.literal: When Hua Jiao raised troops upstream, an edict ordered Minister of Works Chunyu Liang to lead the mass of armies in advance to attack.
translations.idiomatic: When Hua Jiao raised troops upstream, an edict ordered minister of works Chunyu Liang to lead the mass of armies against him.

sentences.zh: 軍至夏口，皎舟師彊盛，莫敢進者，廣達首率驍勇，直衝賊軍。

translations.literal: When the army reached Xiakou, Jiao's fleet was strong and none dared advance; Guangda was first to lead elite troops in a straight charge at the rebel army.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached Xiakou, Jiao's fleet was strong and none dared advance; Guangda was first to lead elite troops in a straight charge at the rebels.

sentences.zh: 戰艦既交，廣達憤怒大呼，登艦樓，獎勵士卒，風急艦轉，樓搖動，廣達足跌墮水，沈溺久之，因救獲免。

translations.literal: Once the warships engaged, Guangda shouted in anger, climbed the ship tower, and encouraged the soldiers; the wind was fierce and the ships turned—the tower shook, Guangda's foot slipped and he fell into the water; he was submerged a long while and was then rescued and escaped.
translations.idiomatic: Once the warships engaged, Guangda shouted in anger, climbed the ship tower, and encouraged the soldiers. A fierce wind turned the ships and shook the tower; Guangda's foot slipped and he fell into the water. He was submerged a long while before he was rescued.

sentences.zh: 皎平，授持節、智武將軍、都督巴州諸軍事、巴州刺史。

translations.literal: When Jiao was pacified, Guangda was made Bearer of the Staff, Wise Martial General, Area Commander over Ba military affairs, and Inspector of Ba.
translations.idiomatic: When Jiao was pacified, Guangda was made bearer of the staff, wise martial general, commander over Ba military affairs, and inspector of Ba.

sentences.zh: 太建初，與儀同章昭達入峽口，拓定安蜀等諸州鎮。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Taijian he followed Equaling-Excellencies Zhang Zhaoda into the gorge mouth and expanded and pacified the garrisons of An, Shu, and the rest.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Taijian he followed equaling-excellencies Zhang Zhaoda into the gorge mouth and expanded and pacified the garrisons of An, Shu, and the rest.

sentences.zh: 時周氏將圖江左，大造舟艦於蜀，并運糧青泥，廣達與錢道戢等將兵掩襲，縱火焚之。

translations.literal: At that time the Zhou clan was plotting the lands south of the Yangtze and built many ships in Shu, also transporting grain to Qingni; Guangda with Qian Daoji and others led troops in a masked strike and set fire and burned them.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou were then plotting south of the Yangtze and built many ships in Shu, also shipping grain to Qingni; Guangda with Qian Daoji and others raided them, set fire, and burned them.

sentences.zh: 以功增封并前二千戶，仍還本鎮。

translations.literal: For merit his enfeoffment was increased with the former to two thousand households; he still returned to his original command.
translations.idiomatic: For merit his fief was increased with the former to two thousand households, and he returned to his original command.

sentences.zh: 廣達為政簡要，推誠任下，吏民便之。

translations.literal: Guangda's governance was simple and essential; he extended sincerity and entrusted subordinates—the officials and people found it convenient.
translations.idiomatic: Guangda governed simply and sincerely, trusting his subordinates; officials and people found it easy.

sentences.zh: 及秩滿，皆詣闕表請，於是詔留二年。

translations.literal: When his term ended, all went to court with memorials requesting him; an edict thereupon kept him two years more.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended, all went to court to request him; the court thereupon kept him two years more.

sentences.zh: 五年，眾軍北伐，略淮南舊地，廣達與齊軍會於大峴，大破之，斬其敷城王張元範〔一二〕，虜獲不可勝數。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the mass of armies marched north, recovering the old Huainan lands; Guangda met the Qi army at Great Xian and inflicted a great defeat, beheading their Fucheng King Zhang Yuanfan, Editorial footnote marker 12. captives and booty beyond counting.
translations.idiomatic: In year 5 the armies marched north and recovered old Huainan. Guangda met Qi at Great Xian, routed them, and beheaded their Fucheng king Zhang Yuanfan [12]; captives and booty were beyond counting.

sentences.zh: 進克北徐州，乃授都督北徐州諸軍事、〔北〕徐州刺史。

translations.literal: Advancing, he captured North Xuzhou and was then made Area Commander over North Xuzhou military affairs and [North] Inspector of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Advancing, he captured North Xuzhou and was then made commander over North Xuzhou military affairs and [north] inspector of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 〔一三〕尋加散騎常侍，入為右衛將軍。

translations.literal: Editorial footnote marker 13. Soon he was additionally made Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry and entered court as Right Guard General.
translations.idiomatic: [13] Soon he was additionally made regular attendant of the scattered cavalry and entered court as right guard general.

sentences.zh: 八年，出為北兗州刺史，遷晉州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he went out as Inspector of North Yanzhou and was moved to Inspector of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 he went out as inspector of North Yanzhou and was moved to inspector of Jin.

sentences.zh: 十年，授使持節、都督合霍二州諸軍事，進號仁威將軍、合州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was made Bearer of the Staff, Area Commander over He and Huo military affairs, promoted to Renwei General, and Inspector of He.
translations.idiomatic: In year 10 he was made bearer of the staff, commander over He and Huo military affairs, promoted to renwei general, and inspector of He.

sentences.zh: 十一年，周將梁士彥將兵圍壽春，詔遣中領軍樊毅、左衛將軍任忠等分部趣陽平、秦郡，廣達率眾入淮，為掎角以擊之。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year Zhou General Liang Shiyan led troops to besiege Shouyang; an edict sent Central Army Commander Fan Yi, Left Guard General Ren Zhong, and others in detachments toward Yangping and Qin commandery; Guangda led troops into the Huai as a pincer to strike them.
translations.idiomatic: In year 11 Zhou general Liang Shiyan besieged Shouyang; the court sent central army commander Fan Yi, left guard general Ren Zhong, and others in detachments toward Yangping and Qin commandery while Guangda led troops into the Huai as a pincer.

sentences.zh: 周軍攻陷豫、霍二州，南、北兗、晉等各〔自〕拔，〔一四〕諸將並無功，盡失淮南之地，廣達因免官，以侯還第。

translations.literal: The Zhou army captured Yu and Huo provinces; South Yan, North Yan, Jin, and the rest each [withdrew] of themselves, Editorial footnote marker 14. the generals all without merit, utterly losing the Huainan lands; Guangda was therefore dismissed from office and returned to his marquisate as a marquis.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou captured Yu and Huo; South Yan, North Yan, Jin, and the rest each [withdrew] on their own [14]; the generals won nothing and Huainan was wholly lost. Guangda was dismissed and returned to his marquisate.

sentences.zh: 十二年，與豫州刺史樊毅率眾北討，〔一五〕克郭默城。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, with Inspector of Yu Fan Yi he led troops on the northern expedition, Editorial footnote marker 15. and captured Guo Mo's city.
translations.idiomatic: In year 12, with Yu inspector Fan Yi, he led a northern expedition [15] and captured Guo Mo's city.

sentences.zh: 尋授使持節、平西將軍、都督郢州以上十州諸軍事，〔一六〕率舟師四萬，治江夏。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Bearer of the Staff, Pacify-West General, Area Commander over the military affairs of the ten provinces above Ying, Editorial footnote marker 16. led a naval force of forty thousand, and stationed at Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made bearer of the staff, pacify-west general, commander over the military affairs of the ten provinces above Ying [16], led forty thousand naval troops, and stationed at Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 周安州總管元景將兵寇江外，〔一七〕廣達命偏師擊走之。

translations.literal: Zhou's Anzhou Area Commander Yuan Jing led troops to raid the lands outside the river, Editorial footnote marker 17. Guangda ordered a detached division to strike and drive him off.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou's Anzhou area commander Yuan Jing raided lands outside the river [17]; Guangda sent a detached division that struck and drove him off.

sentences.zh: 後主即位，入為安左將軍。

translations.literal: When Houzhu succeeded, Guangda entered court as Pacify-Left General.
translations.idiomatic: When Houzhu succeeded, Guangda entered court as pacify-left general.

sentences.zh: 尋授平南將軍、南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: Soon he was made Pacify-South General and Inspector of Southern Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he was made pacify-south general and inspector of Southern Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 至德二年，授安南將軍，徵拜侍中，又為安左將軍，改封綏越郡公，封邑如前。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhide he was made Secure-South General, summoned and appointed Palace Attendant, again made Pacify-Left General, and re-enfeoffed as Duke of Suiyue commandery with a fief as before.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhide year 2 he was made secure-south general, summoned as palace attendant, again made pacify-left general, and re-enfeoffed as duke of Suiyue commandery with the same fief.

sentences.zh: 尋為中領軍。
